label: Align automatically
tooltip: Largest plane on XY, largest plane perpendicular to it on XZ, origin at the corner of the scan.
help: The largest plane of the scan becomes the XY plane, the largest plane perpendicular to it the XZ plane; the origin lies at the corner of the bounding box. The new coordinate system is shown over the scan until OK. Turn over, Reverse X and Rotate 90° correct the orientation. Before OK, check that the largest plane is close to 0° to XY.
